flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist).
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy.
Add a bill named Rent with amount 900.00, paid by Ana, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy.

Open Settle up.
Mark each listed payment as paid, one by one.
Look at the Settle up page after the last payment is marked paid.
Assert Each payment disappears from the list once marked paid.
Assert Settle up says "All settled".
Get The status message shown in Settle up after all payments are marked paid and save as {{settled_message}}.
